author: HBO Max
description:
The Lanterns finale left DC fans with a LOT to talk about. On Season 2, Episode 11 of DC Studios Showcase: The Official Podcast, Frankey and Coy sit down with co-executive producers Chris Mundy, Damon Lindelof, and Tom King to break down the explosive finale, the new Green Lantern oath, John Stewart's journey, Hal Jordan's past, and the twists behind the Manhunters.

⚠️Spoilers ahead! Get exclusive behind-the-scenes insight into how the Lanterns team built the season, why John needed his own oath, how Hal's generational trauma reshaped his character, and what those final revelations mean for the Lanterns going forward.

✅ Chris Mundy, Damon Lindelof, and Tom King reveal how the new Green Lantern oath came together
✅ The creators explain the generational trauma that changed how we see Hal Jordan
✅ John Stewart's relationship with the Guardians, his parents, and his own identity gets a deeper look
✅ Frankey and Coy break down the Manhunter reveal, Noah, Zoe, and the finale's biggest twi
